 Serie B - Game Week 12 20 Nov 2026 - 11:30 Stadio M. A. Bentegodi DAZN and LaB Channel will show Hellas Verona v Cesena live. Here's how to follow the match on TV and via live stream.
 Hellas Verona and Cesena meet at Verona's Bentegodi in Serie B, with different aims and contrasting recent form.
 Marco Baroni's Hellas sit fifth and want to cement their place in the play-off positions. Convincing wins and draws have kept them in touch with their rivals in recent weeks.
 Alessandro Diamanti's Cesena travel to Verona in 12th, buoyed by a run of positive results that has restored confidence at the Romagna club. They have shown character lately, picking up important points against direct rivals.
 Baroni also has home advantage. The Bentegodi has historically been a difficult place for visiting Serie B teams to win, and the Verona crowd could make the difference in a close match.
 Diamanti has built a compact side who are hard to beat and capable of getting results away from home. Cesena make the trip knowing they can get a result.
